subject: integration
name: Ask each time (magnet:)
summary: Built-in row for magnet: links while no app is chosen. It has no handler and connects to nothing: the browser's link gate refuses a link outside a strict magnet grammar, then asks the person, naming the page and the link, whether to hand it to an app that lists the scheme and holds a grant, or to the system's default app. What that app then does is the person's step outside Orivon and is not part of this row. Level 4 with privacy; it would drop if a link left unasked. Judged here by its publisher.
